lines.t: I'm buckling beneath the pressure, life's demands
Reaching for escapes in all the wrong hands
Chasing quick comforts, pleasure that fades
Craving relief from the weight these worries make
Response, wisdom in my shriac
Brothers, searching for strength in fleeting pleasures only leaves a man emptier
Real rest is found by refusing the poison offered by the world and standing firm
As my she-hafted peace comes when a man lays his anxieties before the feet of the king and draws near
The Spirit fills what is surrendered
Making a son mighty in discipline and hope
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Confession
When they throw words like daggers and accuse
I rush to defend, fight, and explain my truth
None of it frees me, just another day
Tangled up, yoked to the old way
Response, wisdom in my tree
Let accusations fall without reply
Vindication does not come from men
But from Mashiach alone
A true brother walks away from the urge to explain
Refusing to be tied to those who pull him away
From righteousness, integrity is proven
Not by words, but by silent obedience
Obedience and faithful living.
The reward and freedom are found in the judgment of Messiah.
Never in arguments with men.
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
See these old scars and patterns run deep
Reacting to pain, not knowing the sea
Is this my sorrow, wounds from the past
Where is the root and will healing come at last?
Response, wisdom in Mashiach
Healing burns brightest when a man takes full responsibility
Exposing every hurt and habit to the light
Instead of offering excuses or blame
Root out the flesh by surrender
And trust the King with both pain and sin
Holding nothing back, true restoration
Is born in humility
Where brokenness is met with mercy
And what was secret is touched by the hands
Of Mashiach for new life
The call in Mashiach
Take hold of the yoke
That Mashiach bore
Cast off the burden, let's strive no more
Turn from the fleeting, refuse the shame
Rise now as sons, He calls each one by name
Vassio
Vassio
We'll be right back.
